hero.body: Explore common autistic traits through a structured screening questionnaire designed for adults. Your results can help you decide whether a professional evaluation may be worth discussing.

educational.heading: Understanding autism in adults
educational.intro: Autism can present very differently across individuals. Some adults only begin to explore the possibility later in life.

sensory.title: Sensory experiences
sensory.body: Some autistic adults report heightened or reduced sensitivity to sound, light, texture, or other sensory input — experiences that may be subtle or significant.

executive.title: Focus and routines
executive.body: Some autistic adults describe strong patterns of focus, a preference for predictability, or difficulty managing unexpected changes in routine.

social.title: Social communication
social.body: Some autistic adults experience differences in social communication — not deficits, but differences in how connection, conversation, and context are experienced.

educational.imageAlt: Abstract editorial illustration representing sensory experiences, routines, and focus through overlapping circles
educational.humanAlt: Two adults having a calm, thoughtful conversation at a coffee shop

step1.title: Explore
step1.body: Learn what the screening is designed to explore and what it cannot tell you.

step2.title: Answer
step2.body: Complete a structured questionnaire at your own pace. One question at a time.

step3.title: Understand
step3.body: Review your screening results and the evidence behind each response.

step4.title: Decide
step4.body: Choose whether discussing the results with a qualified professional makes sense for you.

screeningPreview.heading: Designed to reduce cognitive load
screeningPreview.question: Do you find unexpected changes in routine difficult to manage?

privacy.heading: Your answers are yours.
privacy.pillar1: Your answers are used only to calculate your screening result.
privacy.pillar2: You choose whether to generate or share a report.
privacy.pillar3: We collect only what is necessary.

diagnosisDisclaimer.heading: Screening is not diagnosis.
diagnosisDisclaimer.body: A screening questionnaire can identify patterns that may be worth exploring further. It cannot determine whether someone is autistic or replace an assessment by a qualified clinician.
diagnosisDisclaimer.screeningDesc: Identifies patterns that may justify further exploration with a professional.
diagnosisDisclaimer.diagnosisDesc: Requires a comprehensive assessment by a qualified professional.

resultsPreview.heading: Understand what your responses suggest.
resultsPreview.body: Your result is clear and contextualised — showing what your responses indicated across different dimensions, and what that may or may not mean.
resultsPreview.score: Your responses indicate some traits that may be worth discussing with a professional.
resultsPreview.imageAlt: Abstract structured pattern representing organised screening data

evidence.heading: Understand how your result was reached.
evidence.body: Your result is not a black box. Explore each dimension the questionnaire measured and how your answers contributed.

item1.title: Sensory processing
item1.body: How you experience sensory information, including over- or under-sensitivity to input.

item2.title: Social communication
item2.body: Patterns in how you experience social interaction, nonverbal cues, and conversation.

item3.title: Executive function
item3.body: How you plan, organise, switch tasks, and manage routines and transitions.

item4.title: Repetitive behaviours
item4.body: The presence of focused interests, routines, or repetitive patterns that provide comfort or structure.

pdf.heading: Take your results with you.
pdf.body: Generate a professional screening report to share with a clinician, therapist, or GP. The report includes your responses, scores, and important limitations.
pdf.disclaimer: This is a screening report, not a diagnostic document.

clinicians.heading: Want to explore this further?
clinicians.body: After completing a screening, you can choose to discuss your results with a qualified professional. Auren helps you find the right person.
clinicians.imageAlt: A professional and a client in a calm, thoughtful consultation setting
